name: monsters_everything
arguments: uint16 first_mob_offset
return: void
exceptional_convention: frameless wrapper saves D2-D7/A2-A6 before reading the normal first stack argument

name: monster_loop_core
arguments: D2.w current doubled MOB offset; A2-A6 MOB arrays; outer local stack frame
return: no independent return; continues the outer iteration/epilogue

name: monster_special_handler
arguments: D2.w current doubled MOB offset, D4/D5 H/V state, D6.w monster type; A2-A6 MOB arrays; caller-pushed type word
return: no independent return; continues the outer iteration/epilogue
exceptional_convention: interior branch entry sharing monsters_everything registers and stack

name: monster_update_anim_tile
arguments: D2.w current doubled MOB offset, D6.w animation-table selector; A2 picture array, A6 state array
return: no independent return; continues the outer iteration/epilogue
exceptional_convention: interior branch entry sharing monsters_everything registers and stack

name: monster_find_and_shoot
arguments: D2.w current doubled MOB offset; A2/A3/A4 picture/H/V arrays, A6 state array; caller-pushed monster type word
return: void
exceptional_convention: BSR-only shared-stack entry; reads the type word at 8(A6) after LINK

name: find_unused_shot
arguments: D4.w initial doubled shot offset; A2 picture array
return: D4.w selected doubled shot offset; Z set when both mob_picture[D4] and the word at 0x904926+D4 are zero

name: monster_shooter_in_view
arguments: D4.b horizontal coordinate, D5.b vertical coordinate
return: D4.l = -1 in view or 0 outside; Z reflects result

name: apply_direction_from_delta
arguments: D2.w current offset, D3.w target offset, D4/D5 current H/V; A3/A4 H/V arrays, A6 state array
return: void; writes direction bits in the current MOB state

name: monster_create_shot
arguments: uint16 monster_slot, uint16 direction, uint16 shot_slot
return: void

name: handle_generate
arguments: uint16 generator_slot, uint16 generated_type, uint16 spawn_probability
return: void

name: monster_playerhit
arguments: uint16 player_slot, uint16 monster_slot
return: void

name: shot_mob_collision
arguments: uint16 shot_mob_slot, uint16 shooter_id
return: D0.w target slot or -1 when no collision
exceptional_convention: frameless leaf reads both normal stack arguments before saving D2-D7/A2-A3

name: shot_collision_candidate_core
arguments: D0.w candidate offset, D1.w doubled shooter offset, D3.w axis limit, D4.w self offset, D5.w sum limit, D6/D7 shot H/V; A0/A1/A2 H/V/picture arrays
return: D0.w retained/tagged candidate offset; D2.w candidate type/result or -1; N signals rejection

name: resolve_shot_hit
arguments: uint16 target_slot_or_playfield_code, uint16 shooter_id
return: D0.l = 0 shot survives or -1 shot consumed

name: shot_onscreen_check
arguments: uint16 target_slot, uint16 horizontal_limit, uint16 vertical_limit
return: D0.l = -1 in range or 0 outside

name: shot_reflect_calc
arguments: uint16 target_slot_or_playfield_code, uint16 shooter_id
return: D0.w reflected direction

name: wall_crumble
arguments: uint16 packed_slot, uint16 damage
return: D0.l = -1 wall destroyed or 0 wall remains

name: dragon_shot_hit
arguments: uint16 target_slot, uint16 shooter_id
return: void

name: dragon_shot_hitbox_adjust
arguments: D0.w candidate offset, D3.w axis limit, D5.w sum limit, D6/D7 shot H/V
return: D0.w candidate offset, plus 0x1000 on head overlap
exceptional_convention: register-argument leaf called only by shot_mob_collision; clobbers D2/D6/A3

name: shot_impact_spawn
arguments: uint16 target_slot, uint16 shooter_slot
return: void
